'''Kargrek''' was a [[Jungle Felucian/Legends|Felucian]], who lived during the early months of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
Kargrek lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], but was captured by the Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vischera]] and taken to an [[Vanishing Place|Imperial prison]]. Vischera [[Mutant|changed]] Kargrek's genetic code, making the Felucian larger, more violent and fully obedient to the Captain. Vischera oversaw the combat training of Kargrek and [[Hagark]], another similarly altered Felucian, eventually making them his personal bodyguards. When Vischera attacked a group of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] agents that had infiltrated the prison, Kargrek and Hagark accompanied him.
